messages.subject: throwing errors, part 2
parts:
I'm referring to http://groups.google.com/group/rapache/t/547719be9f08f2ca
. I have essentially arrived at the same solution that Brad did:

RFileHandler /var/www/R/bar.R::handler

and then I have handler() process the HTTP parameters and call my main
code.

Now, Brad's handler() always returned DONE. I see this in the rapache
manual: "If the function or script would like to signal an error
condition, then it should return an object with an S3 class of 'try-
error' (read the R documentation for try and tryCatch for further info
on the 'try-error' class)."

Could you give an example for how the try-error pattern would be used
[1] within handler(), and [2] within some function called from (some
function called from) handler()?

Thanks in advance.
